info.name: ParaSwap Market API v5 prices transactions API

description.content:
The ParaSwap Market API (now Velora Market API) provides real-time optimal swap routing across 170+ DEXes on 12 EVM-compatible chains. Retrieve price quotes with optimal routes, build transaction call data, or combine both in a single call. Supports the Augustus v5 smart contract.
